Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

As hideously deformed as their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} kin, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} make their havens in the sewers and forgotten places beneath @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}-held cities, serving the sect as spies, scouts, and information brokers from the shadows.

Disciplines: Animalism, Obfuscate, Potence

Advantage: All Nosferatu gain at least one Trait of Stealth at no cost, and one Ability Trait of Survival.

Disadvantage: No Nosferatu may possess the Social Traits Alluring, Gorgeous or Seductive (without powers such as Obfuscate), and they suffer the Negative Social Traits Repugnant x3 (which can never be removed) whenever their true form is apparent. A Nosferatu cannot initiate Social Challenges except for intimidation.

Organization: Nosferatu antitribu maintain extensive underground networks beneath Sabbat territory, trading information and favors in exchange for protection and standing.
